title: Tarte Tatin French Classic
description: A traditional French dessert made by caramelizing apples in butter and sugar, then topping with pastry.
instructions: Peel, core, and halve the apples.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the brown sugar and cook, stirring occasionally, until caramelized.
Add the apples to the skillet and cook until tender.
Roll out the pastry dough to fit the skillet.
Place the pastry over the apples and tuck the edges under.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
Invert the tart onto a serving plate and drizzle with heavy cream.
